# CANDIDATE: MARKET_STRUCTURE_BOS_WITH_VOLUME_SPIKE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
A break of market structure (BOS) accompanied by a volume spike >2× average signals strong institutional participation and a high‑probability continuation. This edge exists because institutional algorithms often defend or break key swing levels with elevated volume, creating follow-through momentum.

## Mechanism
Identify the most recent swing high (HH) and swing low (HL) using pivot points. A bullish BOS occurs when price closes above the prior swing high; a bearish BOS when price closes below the prior swing low. When a BOS bar forms and its volume > 2 × the average volume of the prior 20 five‑minute bars, enter long on a bullish BOS (close above prior swing high) or short on a bearish BOS (close below prior swing low). Exit: Stop at the swing point that was broken (prior swing low for longs, prior swing high for shorts). Target at 1.5× risk or trail using 20% of ATR from the highest‑since‑entry watermark. Regime filter: Only trade when EMA20 > EMA50 and rising (upward‑sloping ribbon) AND VIX < 22; avoid entries when ADX < 20 (choppy conditions).
